postconditions.description: The permutation p has exactly n elements.
The permutation q has exactly n - 2 elements.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= pi <= n for pi in p)
postconditions.description: Each element in p is an integer between 1 and n, inclusive.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= qi <= n - 2 for qi in q)
postconditions.description: Each element in q is an integer between 1 and n - 2, inclusive.
The elements in p are all distinct.
The elements in q are all distinct.

postconditions.expression: all(cutting_sequence(p, q) == original_cake for cutting_sequence in possible_sequences(p))
postconditions.description: For each permutation p and q, the cutting sequence must result in the original cake.

invariants.description: The number of vertices in the cake is at least 3.
The number of vertices in the cake is at most 10^5.
The number of test cases is at most 1000.
